report_vintage: AIE January 2026 Italian trade market presentation
publication_date_locator: PDF p.1 and AIE press release dated 30 January 2026
press_release_locator: Paragraph beginning 'In un anno di mercato in sofferenza' identifies ebook sales and audiobook subscriptions
population_and_period: Adult and children's trade books in Italy. The print retail panel covers participating bookstore, online and mass retail channels. The format breakdown uses additional sources. The figures measure transactions and subscriptions. Calendar years 2024 and 2025. No audience recall period.
price_basis: PDF p.2, actual prices include discounts and promotions. PDF p.6, EUR million at realized sale prices. VAT basis is unspecified in the cited January chart and methods slide.

prior_or_different_scopes.notes: This release includes fairs and minor outlets in the broader trade total, with education, professional products and exports in the overall total. The scope differs from the January format series.
Separate historical retail-price publishing value in USD million.

added_observations.scope: Italy adult and children's trade print books. The NielsenIQ BookData panel covers chain and independent bookstores, online retailers and mass retail book stands. Smaller and specialist outlets, fairs, direct sales and comic book shops are outside the panel.
added_observations.evidence_locator: PDF p.6, print and digital spending stacked columns, Libri, 2024 column. Scope and price basis on p.2.
added_observations.notes: Calendar-year consumer spending at realized sale prices including discounts and promotions. VAT basis unspecified. The source uses several data sources for the format breakdown. The January 2026 release supplies both years. The total overlaps the format components. The broader October 2026 AIE trade estimate includes fairs and other outlets.
